external_relations.target_title: investigate xt global-migration hook + asset duplication across consumer projects

source.description:
Found during xtrm-1ehjo. docs/architecture/repair-transaction.md:55-64 states 'Internal cleanup helper stays available' and shows a call signature:

  runOwnedLegacyCleanup({ projectRoot, dryRun, scopes: ['hooks','skills','extensions'] })

grep across cli/src, scripts/ and packages/ finds the identifier ONLY in that doc — there is no implementation, export, or call site. Same for the ReconciliationOutcome interface at :16, which is a doc-only type sketch with no TypeScript counterpart in the codebase.

Consequence: the doc reads as an API contract and sends implementers looking for code that isn't there (it sent this investigation down that path). Either implement the helper as documented, or downgrade the section to an explicit design proposal so it stops reading as available surface.

scripts/dedupe-legacy-hooks.mjs emits the documented ReconciliationOutcome field names (changed/planned/applied/preserved/failed) by hand so that a future implementation has a consumer to stay compatible with.
